title: A change to the watch's release signing is not rehearsed before a release
what: The watch build check says it rehearses the release's signing with a throwaway key, but it only starts on a push when watch files change. A change to the shared signing script or the same-key check alone starts no rehearsal, so a mistake there is first seen when a release is tagged.
expected: A push that changes the release signing script or the same-key check starts the watch build check and its signing rehearsal.
how_often: every push that changes only the signing script or the same-key check
fix_line: Add the signing script and the same-key check to the watch build's push list
